title: Northstar Commerce
summary: A headless storefront with instant search, editorial product pages, and a calm checkout.
description: Northstar is a Next.js storefront for independent brands. Catalog data lives in Postgres, images are optimized at the edge, and checkout stays on a single page so nothing feels like a funnel. I designed the product templates, built the cart, and wired Stripe without turning the UI into a theme.

title: Lumen Analytics
summary: A metrics dashboard that makes team health readable in one glance — no 40-widget soup.
description: Lumen replaces noisy BI screens with a few honest charts, saved views, and role-aware filters. Built as a Next.js app with streamed server components, it loads the shell first and paints charts as queries resolve. I owned the data model, chart system, and the empty states that actually explain what to do next.

title: Fieldnote
summary: A writing app for people who think in fragments and later want a finished page.
description: Fieldnote stores notes as markdown, supports inline /commands, and publishes a public garden when you are ready. Offline-first on the client, synced through a small Node API. I designed the typography, keyboard flows, and the publish pipeline.

title: Atlas Stay
summary: A stay-booking interface that treats maps, dates, and rooms as one continuous gesture.
description: Atlas Stay is a booking UI kit turned into a working product: map-linked listings, price calendars, and a guest flow that never dumps you into a new layout. I built the search, availability engine hooks, and the responsive map/list split.
